description: How to estimate the hidden state of a moving system from noisy sensors: Bayes filters, Kalman filters and their nonlinear extensions, particle filters, localisation, mapping, smoothing with factor graphs and multi-sensor fusion. Students derive the filters, implement them from scratch and test consistency on simulated and recorded sensor data.
modelledOn: Thrun, Burgard and Fox, Probabilistic Robotics
Bar-Shalom, Li and Kirubarajan, Estimation with Applications to Tracking and Navigation
outcomes: Derive the Kalman filter from Bayesian recursion and implement linear, extended and unscented filters for a given state-space model.
Implement and tune particle filters, choosing proposal distributions and resampling schemes that avoid weight degeneracy.
Model inertial, satellite-navigation, range and camera sensors, calibrate their errors and reject outliers.
Solve localisation, mapping and pose-graph problems as filtering or nonlinear least-squares estimation on a factor graph.
Fuse multiple sensors loosely and tightly coupled, and evaluate estimator consistency and accuracy with NEES, NIS and trajectory error.

units.title: Probability and estimation foundations
topics: Random vectors, the Gaussian distribution, covariance and Mahalanobis distance
Bayesian estimation: ML and MAP estimates and the Cramer-Rao bound
Least squares: linear, weighted and recursive least squares
State-space models: discrete and continuous time, observability and controllability
Noise models: white and coloured noise, random walk and Allan variance

units.title: Bayes filters
topics: Recursive Bayesian estimation: prediction and update
The discrete Bayes (histogram) filter and grid localisation
The Markov assumption, motion models and measurement models
Hidden Markov models: the forward algorithm and Viterbi decoding
Information form and the idea of filter consistency

units.title: Kalman and extended Kalman filters
topics: Kalman filter derivation: prediction, innovation, gain and the Joseph form
Steady-state gain, the Riccati equation and alpha-beta filters
Tuning Q and R; consistency tests with NEES, NIS and innovation whiteness
Numerical issues: square-root and UD factorisation filters
Extended Kalman filter: linearisation, Jacobians and failure modes
Information filter and continuous-time Kalman-Bucy filter

units.title: Unscented and particle filters
topics: The unscented transform, sigma points and the unscented Kalman filter
Linearisation error compared across EKF, UKF and cubature filters
Particle filters: importance sampling, the SIR filter and weight degeneracy
Resampling schemes: multinomial, systematic and stratified; effective sample size
Rao-Blackwellised particle filters, Gaussian-sum filters and ensemble Kalman filters
Data association: gating, nearest neighbour and joint probabilistic data association

units.title: Sensor models and calibration
topics: Inertial sensors: accelerometer and gyroscope bias, scale factor, noise and random walk
Satellite navigation, wheel odometry, magnetometer and barometer error characteristics
Range and vision sensors: lidar, radar, ultrasonic and camera reprojection models
Calibration: intrinsic and extrinsic parameters and time synchronisation
Outlier rejection: chi-square gating, RANSAC and robust loss functions

units.title: Localisation and mapping
topics: Wheeled-robot motion models: odometry, unicycle and bicycle
Monte Carlo localisation and Markov localisation
Attitude estimation: quaternions, complementary filter and strapdown inertial navigation
EKF-SLAM: landmark maps, observability and inconsistency
FastSLAM and occupancy-grid mapping
Visual and lidar odometry: scan matching with ICP and loop closure

units.title: Smoothing and factor graphs
topics: Filtering versus smoothing: the RTS smoother and fixed-lag smoothing
MAP estimation as nonlinear least squares: Gauss-Newton and Levenberg-Marquardt
Factor graphs, Bayes nets, variable elimination and sparsity
Pose graph optimisation and bundle adjustment
Incremental smoothing, marginalisation and sliding-window estimators
State on manifolds: SO(3) and SE(3), perturbations and Lie group updates

units.title: Multi-sensor fusion
topics: Loosely versus tightly coupled GNSS/INS fusion
Visual-inertial odometry and the error-state Kalman filter
Distributed fusion: covariance intersection and track-to-track fusion
Fault detection: innovation monitoring and integrity checks
Case: fusing low-cost sensors for an agricultural drone or a vehicle tracker in Accra

units.title: Project and research
topics: Designing an estimator for a platform: state definition, models and tuning
Evaluation: RMSE, absolute and relative trajectory error, ground truth and benchmarks
Recent research: learned and differentiable filters and deep sensor fusion
Open problems and project defence

schedule.title: Gaussians, least squares and state-space models
schedule.exercise: Fit a line and a polynomial by recursive least squares, set up a constant-velocity state-space model, and check its observability.

tasks.title: Plot the covariance ellipse of a 2D Gaussian from a given covariance matrix and compute the Mahalanobis distance of three points
Implement recursive least squares for a drifting sensor offset and plot the estimate and its variance against the batch solution
Compute the Allan variance of a recorded gyroscope log and identify the white noise and bias instability coefficients from the plot

schedule.title: Recursive Bayes, grids and hidden Markov models
schedule.exercise: Implement a grid Bayes filter for a robot in a corridor of doors and decode a hidden Markov model with Viterbi.

tasks.title: Step through a histogram filter for a robot in a one-dimensional corridor and record the belief after each move and measurement
Code a grid localisation filter in a 2D map with a noisy range sensor and report the time to localise over ten runs
Implement the forward algorithm and Viterbi decoding for a three-state hidden Markov model, and validate them against brute-force enumeration

schedule.title: The Kalman filter
schedule.exercise: Derive the Kalman filter, apply it to tracking a minibus from noisy GPS positions, and tune the noise matrices with consistency tests.

tasks.title: Perform two predict-update cycles of a scalar Kalman filter by hand and check the gain and variance values
Implement a constant-velocity Kalman filter on simulated GPS data and plot the estimate, error and three-sigma bounds
Run 100 Monte Carlo trials of a tracking filter, compute average NEES and NIS and tune Q and R until the filter is consistent

schedule.title: Numerics and the extended Kalman filter
schedule.exercise: Compare the plain and Joseph covariance updates under poor conditioning, and build an extended Kalman filter for bearing-only tracking.

tasks.title: Compute the Jacobian of a range and bearing measurement model at a given state and linearise the model around it
Show covariance losing positive definiteness in a badly conditioned problem, and fix it with the Joseph form and square-root updates
Implement an EKF for bearing-only tracking, find initial conditions that make it diverge, and propose a fix with evidence

schedule.title: Unscented transform and particle filter basics
schedule.exercise: Propagate a Gaussian through a strong nonlinearity with linearisation, sigma points and sampling, and compare the resulting means and covariances.

tasks.title: Generate sigma points for a 2D Gaussian and push them through a polar-to-Cartesian transform, then compare with Monte Carlo samples
Compare EKF and UKF on a turning-vehicle model with strong nonlinearity, and plot the RMSE of each over 50 runs
Implement a bootstrap particle filter for a nonlinear benchmark model, vary the particle count, and plot the error against run time

schedule.title: Resampling, advanced filters and data association
schedule.exercise: Compare resampling schemes, and build a tracker for multiple targets with gating and nearest-neighbour association.

tasks.title: Watch weights collapse in a particle filter without resampling and note the effective sample size at each step
Implement multinomial and systematic resampling, compare their variance on a test problem, and set an adaptive resampling threshold
Track three crossing targets in clutter with gating and global nearest-neighbour association and report track switches and missed tracks

schedule.title: Sensor models, calibration and outliers
schedule.exercise: Build error models for an IMU and a GNSS receiver from recorded data, calibrate a camera or a gyroscope, and filter outliers.

tasks.title: Estimate the bias and noise of a stationary accelerometer log and generate a synthetic log with the same statistics
Calibrate a gyroscope and a magnetometer on the hardware bench from static and rotation recordings and compare errors before and after
Fit a line to range data with 30 percent outliers using least squares, RANSAC and a robust loss, and compare the three errors

schedule.title: Motion models, Monte Carlo localisation and attitude
schedule.exercise: Localise a wheeled robot with a particle filter, and estimate a phone's orientation by fusing gyroscope and accelerometer readings.

tasks.title: Simulate odometry for a unicycle model with wheel noise and plot how position error grows over a 100-metre path
Implement Monte Carlo localisation on an occupancy map with lidar readings and report the pose error after the robot has moved 20 metres
Fuse gyroscope and accelerometer data using a complementary filter and an EKF on a quaternion state, and compare drift and noise

schedule.title: SLAM and odometry
schedule.exercise: Run EKF-SLAM and a grid-mapping robot on a simulated site, and use scan matching to estimate motion between lidar frames.

tasks.title: Build an occupancy grid from a robot's known poses and lidar scans and mark the free, occupied and unknown cells
Align two lidar scans with iterative closest point and report the estimated rotation and translation error against ground truth
Run EKF-SLAM over repeated loops, show the covariance becoming overconfident, and demonstrate loop closure effects on the map

schedule.title: Smoothing and nonlinear least squares
schedule.exercise: Smooth a trajectory with the RTS smoother, then solve the same problem as nonlinear least squares and draw its factor graph.

tasks.title: Apply a forward Kalman filter and a backward RTS pass to a track and compare the filtered and smoothed errors
Solve a range-only localisation problem with Gauss-Newton and Levenberg-Marquardt and compare their convergence from poor starts
Draw the factor graph for a 10-pose trajectory with odometry, a prior and two loop closures, and write its sparse information matrix

schedule.title: Pose graphs, manifolds and incremental smoothing
schedule.exercise: Optimise a pose graph with loop closures, update the state on a manifold, and compare batch and sliding-window solutions.

tasks.title: Compose and invert 2D and 3D rigid transforms, and check the results against the group properties
Optimise a 2D pose graph with 100 poses and 5 loop closures, then plot the trajectory before and after the optimisation
Implement a sliding-window estimator with marginalisation and compare its accuracy and run time with the full batch smoother

schedule.title: Multi-sensor fusion and fault detection
schedule.exercise: Fuse GNSS, inertial and wheel sensors for a vehicle tracker with a tight and a loose design, and inject sensor faults.

tasks.title: Fuse a GNSS position and an inertial prediction by weighted averaging and see how the weight changes the error
Build an error-state Kalman filter for an inertial unit corrected by GNSS and plot the position error through a 30-second outage
Add innovation-based fault detection to the fusion filter, inject a GNSS jump, and report detection delay and false alarm rate

schedule.title: Estimator design, evaluation and research
schedule.exercise: Design, tune and evaluate an estimator for a chosen platform, then critique one recent learned-filter paper and defend the project.

tasks.title: Compute RMSE and absolute trajectory error for an estimate against ground truth and explain what each metric hides
Write the state, process model and measurement model for a chosen platform and run the filter on the supplied data log
Compare a trained neural network state estimator with a tuned Kalman filter on shifted noise conditions and report where each fails
